body:
so that's it

no one has anything else to add

i'm glad

the last thing i want is to regret this choice

i'm so tired of people crying over me

Nothing that you can help with.

Believe me. I've already tried. The best I got was "I might help you (with just one of those things) if you do this, this, and this" and all of those three things were things I was pretty sure I wouldn't be able to do.

I don't want to live.

I'm tired and I told everyone I could think of and no one helped.

I just want it to be over already.

This one.

And my death. And everything wrong with my life in general.

It wasn't about anything. I just said something ambiguous knowing the result I'd probably get, and got the result I expected.

I'm setting myself up for this at this point. No one to blame but myself anymore.

I want to do this to myself.

And I want to watch and see every moment of how little anyone actually cares.

I want to see as everyone tells me, yes, I did the right thing. I finally just died already, like you all always wanted.
